title: Refund Value of Companion Taxes and Fees (Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes)
content:
**Clause.** Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, the refund of the taxes and fees of a cancelled booking is the amount of the most recent taxes-and-fees charge on the certificate, refunded in full.

## Definitions

- **Taxes-and-fees charge** — the charge entry of component taxes and fees with the latest entry date in the trip and charge history of the certificate or pass.
- **Final refund processing charge** — the processing charge multiplied by one minus the combined waiver percentage, rounded half up to the cent; the waiver percentages are first added into one combined waiver percentage that is applied once, never one after the other.
- **Taxes-and-fees refund** — the taxes-and-fees amount that comes back less the final refund processing charge, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

| Step | Value |
|---|---|
| Most recent taxes-and-fees charge on the certificate | 42.35 USD |
| Taxes and fees coming back | 42.35 USD, in full |
| Processing charge | none |
| Taxes-and-fees refund | 42.35 USD |

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
